sloka: ज्ञात्वा तस्य तु तद्वृत्तं भरद्वाजो महामुनिः ।ददौ विश्रवसे भार्यां स्वसुतां देववर्णिनीम् ।। ७.३.३ ॥
transliteration: jñātvā tasya tu tadvṛttaṁ bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ ।dadau viśravase bhāryāṁ svasutāṁ devavarṇinīm ।। 7.3.3 ॥

translations.english: Understanding Vishrava's excellent character, the great sage Bharadvaja gave his own daughter, Devavarnini, as a wife to Vishrava.
